_comment: Wave-5.5 furniture ratchet baseline. Regenerated by scripts/ratchet/check.sh's own recompute logic — see that script for the exact find/rg commands. Do not hand-edit the counts without rerunning them; hand-edit only the metadata fields (computed_at_commit, computed_date, bump_reason) when intentionally moving the baseline.
computed_at_commit: ce47e61e657690de3df235f9918584662b0d25e0 (main after the wave-6 15-well split merge; measured by check.sh's own recompute at the gated stack top, whose tree is identical)
bump_reason: Wave-6 split the fifteen tier-2 monoliths (56k loc) into directory modules, all moves DOWN-only. giant_files 157 -> 148: fifteen over-bar monoliths retired, six ruled-indivisible over-bar children remain in their place (largest: pipeline/execution.rs at 1,501). allow_attrs 88 -> 87: one reason-carried allow rode with its item into session_overlay/tests.rs, which the ratchet's non-test globs exclude — nothing was added, removed, or reworded. print_macros unchanged at 88.

giant_files.description: Non-test .rs files with >= 800 lines. Non-test = path has no 'tests/' directory component, filename is not 'tests.rs' and does not end '_tests.rs'. vendor/ and target/ excluded.

allow_attrs.description: Occurrences of '#[allow(' under crates/*/src, excluding test files (same non-test definition as giant_files).
allow_attrs._movement_across_the_stack: Net zero against pristine main's 88. The policy plane retires one marker (policy_model.rs carried two; its relay module carries one). The store split raises one: five markers in store.rs become six across store/handle.rs and store/retrieval_telemetry.rs, and the surviving net-new marker is narrowed to the single dead method in that branch's own commit. The batch split adds two allow(unused_imports) shims and then drops both with the dead re-exports they covered, so it leaves no trace here.

_census_ratchet_txt_per_crate_src_column._note: census-ratchet.txt (recon artifact, computed at 5a55db0b) reports a coarser per-crate 'src' figure that sums to 92, not the 88 this baseline enforced at that same commit. Its exclusion only drops paths under a literal tests/ directory, not sibling test-named files (e.g. src/tests.rs, src/authority/tests.rs, src/hnsw/tests.rs) — those still counted as 'src' there. This baseline additionally excludes those sibling test files per the ratchet's own non-test definition above. Kept here for provenance, not as the enforced number.

print_macros.description: Combined occurrences of println!, eprintln!, and dbg! under crates/*/src, excluding test files (same non-test definition as giant_files). Counted with word-boundary-anchored patterns so 'eprintln!' lines are not double-counted by a bare 'println!' substring match.

_census_ratchet_txt_per_crate_src_column._note: Same test-file-exclusion gap as allow_attrs above (census-ratchet.txt's 'src' column includes sibling tests.rs/*_tests.rs files); its println+eprintln+dbg sum is 136, not 88 here. All 4 of oneiron's census-reported println!/eprintln! hits, for example, are in src/tests.rs and src/hnsw/tests.rs — test files excluded from this baseline.
